ticket.title: Tabbing/Focus issue with dateTime input and altInput and keyboard only navigation

actions.description: Open a plain date picker and select a day in the current month.
Move forward and backward between months and years and inspect the calendar heading and grid.
Navigate with the keyboard and inspect the focused and selected date.
Type or replace the input text, leave the field, and inspect the parsed value.
Select dates in a range or multiple-date mode and check its endpoints and disabled dates.
Change a time field, trigger a time update and inspect the selected hours, minutes and time limits.
